page.notes: The left and right columns are printed side by side on one page; the whole left column was read first, then the right column. Long s is normalised to plain s throughout (e.g. Iussus, signif., testamenti). The printed ff, ss and s forms are ligatures of long s, not real f. Greek headwords (Καλύβη, Καλλιγράφοι, Καρών, Καταδρωμάτα, Κεύοτρι, Κίνητος, Κινδύνια, Κοινάτα, Κρόσσα, Κυβελλα, Κυρίαι δόξαι) are doubtful: the letters are blurred and the accents uncertain. They are marked [?] where they stand. The right-hand line "Lauiniana ficus l.205.§.de verbor.signif." has an unreadable reference number after "l.205.§."; it is copied as far as legible. The last line of the right column is cut at the foot of the page and the final words are doubtful. The page has a small bullet-like mark at the bottom right; it is not text and is left out.
